'''May 2000 Brandon tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Millenium Comics, Brandon, FL on 13 May 2000. [[Neal Razi]] won it. It is known from Neal Razi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d747">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-15-neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000d747/ neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000], DeckTech (Neal "Dredlox" Razi, 15 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-15-neal-dredlox-tampa-fl-may-13-2000d747/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Millenium Comics, Brandon, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Neal Razi]]
